scholarships.title: Hans Wilsdorf Foundation Scholarship (managed by EPFL)
scholarships.official_source: EPFL (Hans Wilsdorf Foundation fund administered by EPFL)

existing.description: Students whose section recommend participating in study trips, with an educational purpose can ask for financial support. Exchange students are not entitled to it.
eligibility: Live in the canton of Geneva, or have applied for a grant from the cantonal scholarship office of the canton of Geneva (SBPE)
Swiss nationality, C permit holder, refugee or Swiss secondary education certificate: as of the CMS
International students: after at least one year at EPFL and successful completion of the first-year cycle
Be in a difficult financial situation under the EPFL social scholarship criteria
existing.eligibility_summary: Need-based fund for EPFL students who live in the canton of Geneva or who have applied to the Geneva cantonal scholarship office (SBPE). Swiss, C permit and refugee students may apply from the CMS; international students only after at least one year at EPFL and successful completion of the first-year cycle. Same assessment criteria as the EPFL social scholarship.
benefits: Financial support of 5 months per semester, up to ten months per academic year
Payment at the start of each semester
coverage: Means-tested financial support paid per academic year
5 months per semester, maximum ten months per year of study
requirements: Tick the "Hans Wilsdorf scholarship" box on the Application form 2026-2027
Meet the same criteria as the EPFL social scholarship
documents: EPFL application form 2026-2027 with the "Hans Wilsdorf scholarship" box ticked
For students who applied to SBPE, the acknowledgement of that application
application_method: Submit the form with the required documents per the EPFL scholarship process
existing.selection_notes: Managed by EPFL under the same subsidiarity test as the EPFL social scholarship.
existing.best_fit: EPFL students resident in the canton of Geneva, or who have applied to the Geneva cantonal scholarship office, whose financial situation has deteriorated.
existing.notes: EPFL routes Geneva students to this fund instead of the EPFL social scholarship.
existing.duration: Per academic year (1 or 2 semesters), 5 months per semester, maximum ten months per year of study
existing.application_period: Two windows a year; the last windows on the page (01.12.26 and 15.02.27) are still ahead of today
existing.deadline_display: Request for Spring 2027: new and renewal application 01.12.26 / 15.02.27 (the 15.07.26 and 15.09.26 windows for Autumn 26 and Spring 27 have passed)
existing.program_type: Need-based scholarship from a private foundation, administered by the university
